texto: **personificación** attributes a human action to an object or phenomenon: **angin malam berbisik** («the night wind whispers»). It is not literally interpreted.
The **ironía** can express a criticism by words that seem to praise; the context reveals the intention. In Spanish, as in Indonesian, translating only words can hide tone or criticism.
